test_title: PYST 74: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six colleagues — Hussain, Anita, Manshaad, Emily, Sunita, and Shanti — are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Hussain is sitting second to the right of Anita. Manshaad is an immediate neighbour of both Emily and Anita. Sunita is sitting second to the left of Manshaad. Who is sitting second to the left of Shanti?
solution:
Given: Anita, Hussain, Manshaad, Emily, Sunita and Shanti are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Hussain is sitting second to the right of Anita.

Manshaad is an immediate neighbour of both Emily and Anita.

Sunita is sitting second to the left of Manshaad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4a9c5cc1e7ba87fecbfa090e2aab24be37e22fe6e4944d8cabcdc2c19bedd37.png] 

So, second to the left of Shanti is Manshaad.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
